answer: Entrusted physiotherapist registration with physiotherapy council attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a registration the council renews after assessed treatments, the relic of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the haven first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The nectar is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
